// divguard:path coding/session.go

package coding

import "os"

type store struct{}

func (store) AppendMessage(msg string) (string, error) { return msg, nil }
func (store) AppendLabelChange(id, label string) error { return nil }

type Session struct {
	inner store
	ids   []string
}

// persistMessage reproduces AGENT-05: a failed append only skips the
// bookkeeping, and the transcript silently stops being saved.
func (s *Session) persistMessage(msg string) {
	if id, err := s.inner.AppendMessage(msg); err == nil { // want
		s.ids = append(s.ids, id)
	}
}

func (s *Session) label(id, label string) {
	_ = s.inner.AppendLabelChange(id, label) // want
}

func saveSettings(path string, data []byte) {
	_ = os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755)        // want
	_ = os.WriteFile(path, data, 0o600) // want
}

// persistQuietly reproduces CDG-001: the error return is ignored entirely,
// or blanked while the id is kept.
func (s *Session) persistQuietly(msg string) {
	s.inner.AppendMessage(msg)          // want
	id, _ := s.inner.AppendMessage(msg) // want
	s.ids = append(s.ids, id)
}
